title: socket-patch selection filter
description: The file `socket-patch scan --selection-filter <FILE>` reads: what one scan need not patch. See docs/selection-filter.md. The file must also be at most 16 MiB and hold no duplicate keys, which a schema cannot say.

version.description: The format version. This schema describes version 1; a reader refuses any other.

skip.description: What to leave alone whatever its reachability.

paths.description: Project roots to leave alone: gitignore patterns relative to the repository root, matched against each root's lockfiles like socket.yml's `patches.ignorePaths`.

advisories.description: Advisories that need no fix. A patch is withheld when every advisory it fixes needs none; a patch that also fixes a needed advisory is still applied.

reachability.description: What the caller's reachability analysis found. An `unreachable` advisory needs no fix; a `reachable` or `unknown` one does.

unlistedAdvisories.description: What an advisory no finding covers needs: `patch` treats it as unknown (it needs a fix), `skip` as needing none, which makes the findings an allowlist.

pathPattern.description: A gitignore pattern, at most 1024 bytes, with no `..` segment, drive letter or NUL byte. A leading `!` negates. A leading `#` would make it a comment, so it is refused: write `\#`.

packageSpec.description: A package in the `--package` grammar, at most 1024 bytes: a name (`lodash`, `@scope/pkg`), or a purl with a version (`pkg:npm/lodash@4.17.20`, that release only) or without one (`pkg:npm/lodash`, every version). Qualifiers are ignored. A bare name matches in every ecosystem, so prefer purls; it takes no version (`lodash@4.17.20` is refused).

advisoryId.description: A GHSA or CVE id, in any letter case. It matches an advisory by its id or by one of its CVE aliases.

finding.description: One reachability result. It names an advisory, a package, or both: both means that advisory in that package, an advisory alone means it in every package, a package alone means every advisory in it.

state.description: `unknown` counts as reachable: the advisory needs a fix.
